limitations: Exploratory retrospective archive already inspected in previous experiments; not pristine holdout.
Odds observed_at and result available_at missing; next-day result availability is an assumption, not verified historical T-30 replay.
Score histories cover bookmaker-listed confirmed games, not guaranteed complete league schedules.
No historical as-of xG, possession counts, starters, bullpen, injuries or lineups; no synthetic substitutions.
Volleyball archived scores may be set counts rather than rally points; no point-total interpretation.
Strong/weak means then-known league-centered Elo +/-50, not final standings; small samples shrink toward zero.
All matched markets evaluated, not deployed historical highlights; multiple markets per event and flat-stake ROI are correlated diagnostics.
Holm covers all leagues, seven paired comparisons and both losses; block-bootstrap p-values are approximate and assume limited dependence.
No-scoring ablation was added after first-run results were inspected. Other model definitions and ridge were not selected using those results.
Frozen ridge and feature definitions are hypotheses, not optimized league weights; no operating promotion allowed.
